name: Raid Leader (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Even unorganized forces can create worthy leaders. The raid leader turns battle by virtue of overwhelming force, always being the first into the fray.

Tough as Nails (Ex)

Raid leaders take point and often deal with threats directly. They have a d12 hit die instead of a d10 and ready one fewer aura each day.

This ability modifies aura.

Rage (Ex)

At 2nd level, a raid leader taps into their own fury and gains the ability to rage as a barbarian of their class level.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Motivating Rage (Ex)

At 4th level, a raid leader’s rage is so mighty that it can spread to others. First, the raid leader gains a rage power using their class level as their effective barbarian level for this and any future rage powers which require one. In addition, when a raid leader enters a rage they may choose any number of allies within 30 feet, willing allies enter rage just as the raid leader would using their rage bonus and number of rage rounds remaining for the day. If a raid leader has any rage powers, their allies gain the use of them as well.

This ability replaces tactician.

Rage Power (Ex)

At 8th level and again at 16th level, a raid leader gains a rage power using their class level as their effective barbarian level for rage powers that require one. This replaces the bonus teamwork feats gained at 8th and 16th level.

Greater Motivating Rage (Ex)

At 12th level, a raid leader’s rage becomes more furious and more inspiring.

The bonuses granted by raging increase to a +6 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution and a +2 bonus to Will saves. In addition, a raid leader gains an additional rage power and increases the distance at which they can share the benefits of their rage to 60 feet. This replaces greater tactician.

Mighty Motivating Rage (Ex)

At 20th level, a raid leader again increases the fury of their rage, increasing the bonus to Strength and Constitution to +8 and the bonus on Will saves to +3. In addition, a raid leader gains two additional rage powers and the distance at which allies may be affected by motivating rage increases to 120 feet.

This ability replaces master tactician.
